description: Typed formulas at the 8,192-character limit, where the engine assumes what Excel does (Taskei P559259288). Column A is typed; the lengths below count UTF-16 units after the =. A1 and A6: LEN of &-joined emoji literals, 8,191 and 8,192 units (each 4,149 characters as Unicode scalars, so only the unit count differs): does the typed limit count UTF-16 units, as the stored one does? A11 and A16: the ASCII controls 1+1+... of 8,191 and 8,192 (T-2709 knows them: accepted, refused). A21 and A26: an open call, =SUM(1+1+... with no closing parenthesis, 8,190 and 8,191 units, which Excel closes: is the length counted before or after it adds the parenthesis? A31: the closed call of 8,190, a control. A36: the emoji formula at 8,023 units, a control. Column C is ISBLANK of the typed cell (TRUE where Excel refused the entry) and column E is LEN(FORMULATEXT).
